notes.title: Vote for us at the DevGAMM Awards!
notes.content: [p]Hey guys! Deep Pixel Melancholy is taking part in DEVGAMM, and the community voting kicked off a few days ago. We’d really appreciate it if you could follow the link below and vote for us.[/p][p][/p][p][url="https://devgamm.fillout.com/community-vote2025" style="button" buttoncolor="#ff8800"]Vote![/url][/p][p][/p][p]It’s simple: enter your email, type in the code you get, then search for Deep Pixel Melancholy and pick it from the dropdown list, and finally click Vote. If we make it into the top five, it’ll give our project a big boost in visibility.[/p][p][/p][p]Thanks a lot, and stay tuned — we’ve got some news coming soon.[/p][p][/p][p][url="https://devgamm.fillout.com/community-vote2025"]https://devgamm.fillout.com/community-vote2025[/url][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45618374/9fc29373a2ef0d2f62d0210acc36ea174aa21fbe.jpg"][/img][/p]

notes.title: 10,000 wishlists for Deep Pixel Melancholy!
notes.content:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45618374/604bc562db5e7bead19d37edee79bd94bf55c34d.jpg"][/img][/p][p]This isn’t just a symbolic milestone, it’s an important point that helps the game get more visibility on Steam. We managed to reach this number of wishlists in just a bit over a month.[/p][p]None of this would have been possible without your support, comments, streams, and all the attention you’ve given to the game. We’re grateful to everyone who believed in our project. You’re the best.[/p][p]Right now, we’re continuing active development so that next winter all players can dive into the atmosphere of northern melancholy. Keep sharing your thoughts about the game, tell your friends about it, and stay tuned for more news.[/p][p][/p][p]All the best,
Dima and Max[/p]

notes.title: Demo Update
notes.content: [p]Hello everyone. It’s been a week since we released the demo, and we’ve gone through all your feedback and tried to fix as many issues as we could. But before we get to the list of changes, we want to say a few words.[/p][p][/p][p]First of all, we’re thrilled by your response! Thank you for the support and for believing in the project. We promise it’s only going to get better from here.[/p][p][/p][p]Second, along with bug reports, you’ve shared a lot of great ideas to improve the game overall. Some of them have already made it into this update. Others will take more time, so we’ve postponed them until release. Please keep sharing your thoughts in the comments — we read and note down everything.[/p][p][/p][p]Now on to the update:[/p][list][*][p]You can now skip through dialogue using the spacebar[/p][/*][*][p]Added the option to turn off mouse click sounds[/p][/*][*][p]Added the option to turn off the typing sound[/p][/*][*][p]You can now switch between windowed and fullscreen modes[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed sound issues, like birds randomly chirping outside the grocery store[/p][/*][*][p]General sound tweaks and improvements[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where text formatting broke at larger font sizes[/p][/*][*][p]Minor improvements to text for better readability[/p][/*][*][p]Missing Steam icons added[/p][/*][*][p]A bunch of bugs fixed[/p][/*][*][p]Added a "Wishlist" button to the main menu[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]Huge thanks to everyone who has already played the demo. If you haven’t tried it yet, we’d love for you to check it out.[/p][p][/p][p]See you soon,[/p][p]Dima and Max[/p]

notes.title: Play Deep Pixel Melancholy demo
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45618374/b808622db2132b6972130c376deba706d87cfc8b.jpg[/img]
Hi everyone! We’ve cleaned up all the bugs (at least we think we did ːsteamhappyː) and we’re excited to share the beginning of the game with you. It turned out just the way we wanted, and now it’s your turn. We really hope you enjoy it.

We’d love to hear what you think — whatever it is. Feel free to leave a comment in the Steam Community or on our socials.
